paper_limitations: This is a fixed US-listed ETF allocation universe, not a historical stock-index constituent universe.
The data came from a public yfinance retrieval; archive source metadata and do not redistribute raw provider data.
The panel is a confirmation candidate only. Its results must remain unseen until the method/configuration is selected on the separate development track.
release_conditions: The selected method and all hyperparameters must be frozen using only the public-us-etf-2010-v1 development contract before any return/model evaluation here.
Record this contract and its validation-report hashes as canonical run inputs, together with all raw-source sidecars.
Obtain an independent market or licensed point-in-time stock-universe replication before making a general outperformance claim.
